content.text:
I wrote the solution to `benchmark/solution.ail`. Running it prints exactly the expected seven lines (`false`, `true`, `true`, `false`, `29`, `28`, `30`).

- **`isLeapYear(year)`** uses the full Gregorian rule: `(y%4==0 && y%100!=0) || y%400==0`. Its contract states that exact rule, so the `y%4==0` shortcut would fail verification.
- **`daysInMonth(month, year)`** returns 29 or 28 for February depending on the leap year, 30 for April, June, September and November, and 31 for every other month. Its contract requires a month from 1 to 12 and guarantees a result between 28 and 31.

`ailang verify` proved both contracts with Z3. `main` has no contract because it only does the printing.

The task mentioned "contract signatures above", but none were included in the prompt. I wrote my own using the parameter order the expected calls imply, `daysInMonth(month, year)`.
